sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ।विभीषणमुवाचेदं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम् ।। ६.११४.९७ ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā paramaprīto rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇamuvācedaṁ vākyajño vākyakovidam ।। 6.114.97 ।।

translations.english: "If I am not performing obsequies to my elder brother, the people in this world will call me ruthless. Again, on hearing his blemishes they will say that it is good not to do it for him."
